description: Mooncake cache service (master + per-node stores) on the provider's own Prometheus exposition, scraped with the GPUStack label chain. Adapted from upstream monitoring/grafana/dashboards/mooncake-core.json (kvcache-ai/Mooncake #5199). TE panels are not included: the transfer engine runs inside the inference engines, which GPUStack cache-service deployments neither configure with MC_TE_METRIC nor scrape. Store data-operation panels are remapped to the 0.3.14 store client exposition (mooncake_client_rpc_*); data-plane volume is visible on the master's BatchGetReplicaList/BatchPut counters.

panels.description: Prometheus scrape health per cache-service instance; the instance port distinguishes the master from the node's store. It does not prove Master Ping, transfer metadata or data-path health; a missing series remains Unknown.

defaults.description: Prometheus scrape health per cache-service instance; the instance port distinguishes the master from the node's store. It does not prove Master Ping, transfer metadata or data-path health; a missing series remains Unknown.
